tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided siphon base and square-root branch numerically, initializing rho near 0.70 while allowing the stated wide fallback bounds. Fresh confirmation will test the resulting model against the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied branch guidance identifies the square-root completion, and five pilot rows suffice to fit its three parameters; fresh confirmation can test it without another measurement.
The supplied mechanism is a reduced readout and the pilot already covers the target horizon.
